subject: Feature alignment & timeline for BrightBank enterprise onboarding
messages:
From: Jamie Ellis <jamie.ellis@brightbank.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightBank requirements for production onboarding

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at BrightBank liked the latency profile and the observability hooks. Procurement wants to lock down a few product commitments before we finalize the contract:

- Per-tenant export of audit logs and inference traces (30 day retention export on-demand)
- Ability to pin model variants at a tenant level (we need strict model affinity for regulated flows)
- A documented SLA for 99.9% inference availability for business hours; fallback behavior when capacity is constrained
- Short-term side lane for residency (we may need a partial VPC residency for a subset of PII flows during pilot)

Can you confirm whether these are doable within an initial 8–10 week onboarding window, and what would be included in a canary?

Contracts copied here are asking for technical bullets to feed the SOW.

Best,
Jamie
Jamie Ellis
Head of Platform Integrations, BrightBank
jamie.ellis@brightbank.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightBank requirements for production onboarding

Jamie — thanks for the clarity. We're excited to get BrightBank running. Quick answers up-front while I loop the product & SE leads:

- Per-tenant export (30d): feasible. We can ship an on-demand export tool that packages audit + trace bundles; need to confirm expected export volume.
- Tenant model pinning: supported in platform, but per-tenant model variants for inference affinity is a feature we would need to gate behind a small rollout (policy + UI + API).
- 99.9% SLA during business hours: this is achievable with Dedicated + routing policy, but we need to enumerate fallback model variants and cost impact.
- Partial residency for subset of traffic: controller-level residency support exists; on-prem/VPC path will require an onboarding timeline and some infra changes.

I've attached a one-page plan (BrightBank_MA_plan.pdf) with proposed milestones and the ask breakdown. Internal owners: Marissa — can you provide a product tradeoff note? Priyom — can you give an engineering estimate for the export/backfill and the model affinity shim? Irene, can you advise on rollout gating and canary approach?

Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachment: BrightBank_MA_plan.pdf (1 page — proposal/ask summary)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Jamie Ellis <jamie.ellis@brightbank.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightBank requirements for production onboarding

Thanks Sean + Jamie — I skimmed the plan and flagged a few tradeoffs. High level: all asks are reasonable, but not all are zero-effort in the 8–10 week window. Specifics: 

1) Per-tenant export (30d) — engineering estimate: core export pipeline exists; we need a per-tenant packaging and secure transfer path (S3 Push or SFTP). If BrightBank accepts a nightly on-demand export (vs streaming), we can deliver in ~4 weeks including tests.

2) Model pinning — server-side pinning with a tenant-configured policy is medium effort (API + small UI surface + compatibility matrix). We can do a limited API-only canary in 6–8 weeks, full UI by Q4.

3) SLA + fallback policy — ops: we can formalize a business-hours SLA if the customer takes Dedicated + region affinity. Engineering needs to define fallback model variants (lower-cost/quantized) and an automatic fallback policy. Work here depends on routing playbooks; estimate 3 weeks for a documented fallback plan, 6 weeks to add automated fallback with testing.

4) Partial residency — this is the riskiest ask. If BrightBank needs VPC uplift for a subset of traffic, we'll want a scoped pilot (one service, bounded data) — plan 8–12 weeks for pilot depending on compliance reviews.

Recommended compromise for the SOW: commit to nightly on-demand exports + API-only model pinning canary + documented SLA with manual fallback in the pilot window. That gives BrightBank most value while keeping engineering scope reasonable.

If BrightBank signs a Reserved/Dedicated commitment, we can accelerate the residency track.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: BrightBank requirements for production onboarding

Quick technical notes / implementation considerations (engineering perspective):

- Export: We need to confirm expected daily token count and trace size. Implementation plan: export worker (per-tenant), manifest file, incremental exports, encryption-at-rest, S3 transfer with customer-provided bucket or SFTP push. Risk: very large exports could block nightly window — consider chunking.

- Model pinning: two possible approaches: 1) routing rule that pins session->model-id (fast, API-level only), 2) model affinity in placement layer (harder; involves scheduler changes). For pilot choose approach #1.

- SLA fallback: implement policy engine to choose fallback model variant by tenant tag; prefer quantized variant under load. We can demo policy toggles in a canary with a small % of traffic.

- Residency: for subset VPC flows, we must support network whitelisting and dedicated ingress. This will require infra tickets and security sign-off.

I've attached a quick latency/sequence estimate for the pinning shim — basic numbers show +8–12ms median token latency on the API-only approach (seq-latency-estimate.csv).

If we prioritize the export + API pinning as the canary, I estimate 3 engineers (2 infra, 1 platform) for 4–6 weeks to get a safe demo and 6–8 weeks for hardened production.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachments: seq-latency-estimate.csv

Thanks all — good alignment. Summarizing the proposed SOW bullets for Contracts and BrightBank: 

1) Nightly on-demand per-tenant export (30-day window) — deliverable: API + S3/SFTP transfer, 4-week target for canary.
2) API-only tenant model pinning canary — deliverable: routing rule API; demo in 6 weeks.
3) Documented SLA for business hours with manual fallback plan — deliverable: SLO doc + ops runbook in 3 weeks.
4) Scoped partial residency pilot (optional acceleration if Dedicated is purchased) — deliverable: pilot plan; timeline 8–12 weeks.

Product/Eng asks: Irene — can you own the canary plan for items 1 & 2 (assign eng leads + test criteria)? Priyom — please create a short engineering RFC with resource estimates (use your latency CSV). Marissa — I'll need your sign-off on SOW language before I send the final SOW to BrightBank.

Contracts / BrightBank: once we have sign-off on these bullets we can push a 60-day SOW and target a pilot canary by the end of September. Link to deal record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/BRB-2027-042
